articles.title_en: Narrative Asset Pricing: Interpretable Systematic Risk Factors from News Text
articles.title_cn: 叙事资产定价：来自新闻文本的可解释系统性风险因子
articles.abstract_en: We estimate a narrative factor pricing model from news text of The Wall Street Journal. Our empirical method integrates topic modeling (LDA), latent factor analysis (IPCA), and variable selection (group lasso). Narrative factors achieve higher out-of-sample Sharpe ratios and smaller pricing errors than standard characteristic-based factor models and predict future investment opportunities in a manner consistent with the ICAPM. We derive an interpretation of the estimated risk factors from narratives in the underlying article text. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用《华尔街日报》的新闻文本估计了一个叙事因子定价模型。我们的实证方法整合了主题建模（LDA）、潜在因子分析（IPCA）和变量选择（组套索）。叙事因子在样本外实现了更高的夏普比率和更小的定价误差，优于基于特征的标准因子模型，并且以与ICAPM一致的方式预测未来的投资机会。我们从底层文章文本的叙事中推导出估计风险因子的解释。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的在线链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Mandatory Financial Disclosure and M&A Activity
articles.title_cn: 强制性财务披露与并购活动
articles.abstract_en: Taking advantage of the implementation of the 2003 European Commission (EC) directive on financial reporting, we explore the impact of mandatory financial disclosure on mergers and acquisitions (M&A). We find robust evidence that the number (and volume) of private firms becoming an M&A target increases with mandatory disclosure. Analyses of cross-industry differences, deal-level data, and post-deal performance indicate that financial disclosure increases M&A activity by reducing information frictions in the market for corporate control. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 利用2003年欧洲委员会（EC）财务报告指令的实施，我们探讨了强制性财务披露对并购（M&A）的影响。我们发现了强有力的证据表明，成为并购目标的私营企业数量（和交易量）随着强制性披露而增加。对跨行业差异、交易层面数据和交易后绩效的分析表明，财务披露通过减少公司控制权市场中的信息摩擦来增加并购活动。作者已提供互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.abstract_en: We examine whether shareholder votes in environmental and social (ES) proposals are informative about firms’ ES risks. ES proposals are unique in that they nearly always fail. We examine whether mutual funds’ support for these failed proposals contains information about the ES risks that firms face. Higher support in failed ES proposals predicts subsequent ES incidents and the effects of these incidents on shareholder value. Examining the detailed records of fund votes, we find that agency frictions between a group of shareholders contribute to proposal failure. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究股东在环境和社会（ES）提案上的投票是否能够反映企业面临的ES风险。ES提案的独特之处在于它们几乎总是未能通过。我们考察共同基金对这些未通过提案的支持是否包含有关企业所面临ES风险的信息。未通过ES提案中较高的支持率预示着后续ES事件的发生以及这些事件对股东价值的影响。通过检查基金投票的详细记录，我们发现一组股东之间的代理摩擦导致了提案的失败。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终在线发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.title_en: Firm-Level Exposure to Epidemic Diseases: COVID-19, SARS, and H1N1
articles.title_cn: 企业层面的传染病暴露：COVID-19、SARS和H1N1
articles.abstract_en: We construct text-based measures of the primary concerns listed firms associated with the spread of COVID-19 and other epidemic diseases. We identify which firms perceive to lose or gain from a given epidemic and textually decompose the epidemic’s effect on the firm’s demand and supply. We find that the effects of COVID-19 manifest as a simultaneous shock to demand and supply, with both shocks affecting firms’ market valuations in equal measure on average. By contrast, demand-related impacts appear more important in accounting for the observed collapse in firm-level investment during the COVID-19 crisis. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了基于文本的衡量上市公司与COVID-19及其他传染病传播相关的主要担忧的指标。我们识别哪些企业认为在特定传染病中受损或受益，并从文本上分解传染病对企业需求和供给的影响。我们发现，COVID-19的影响表现为需求和供给的同时冲击，平均而言，这两种冲击对企业市场估值的影响程度相当。相比之下，在与需求相关的冲击在解释COVID-19危机期间观察到的企业层面投资崩溃方面显得更为重要。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接相邻处获取。

articles.title_en: Measuring the Expected Effects of the Global Tax Reform
articles.title_cn: 衡量全球税制改革的预期效应
articles.abstract_en: Over 140 countries agreed on a fundamental corporate tax reform in 2021 to be implemented in 2023 and beyond. To measure its potential effects, we study asset price changes within minutes of the reform announcements. We construct proxies for the reform’s costs regarding U.S. companies’ tax burdens and countries’ public finances. Likely exposed companies exhibit significant negative stock returns. Our lower-bound estimates indicate total shareholder value losses of $112.6 billion one day after the reform announcements. Further, likely exposed countries experience increases in sovereign debt credit risk. Our findings inform the cost-benefit analysis of a historical international tax reform. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online.
articles.abstract_cn: 超过140个国家同意在2021年实施一项根本性的企业税制改革，并于2023年及以后实施。为了衡量其潜在影响，我们研究了改革公告发布后几分钟内的资产价格变化。我们构建了改革对美国公司税负和各国公共财政成本的代理变量。可能受影响的公司表现出显著的负股票回报。我们的下限估计表明，在改革公告发布一天后，股东总价值损失达112.6亿美元。此外，可能受影响的国家主权债务信用风险增加。我们的研究结果为这一历史性国际税制改革的成本效益分析提供了信息。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。

articles.title_en: Inflation and Individual Investors’ Behavior: Evidence from the German Hyperinflation
articles.title_cn: 通货膨胀与个人投资者行为：来自德国恶性通货膨胀的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze how individual investors respond to inflation. We introduce a unique data set containing information on local inflation and security portfolios of more than 2,000 clients of a German bank between 1920 and 1924, covering the German hyperinflation. We find that individual investors buy fewer (sell more) stocks when facing higher local inflation. This effect is more pronounced for less sophisticated investors. Moreover, we document a positive relation between local inflation and forgone returns following stock sales. Our findings are consistent with individual investors suffering from money illusion. Alternative explanations, such as consumption needs, are unlikely to drive our results. Authors have furnished an Internet Appendix, which is available on the Oxford University Press Web site next to the link to the final published paper online
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了个人投资者如何应对通货膨胀。我们引入了一个独特的数据集，其中包含1920年至1924年间德国一家银行超过2,000名客户的当地通货膨胀和证券投资组合信息，涵盖了德国恶性通货膨胀时期。我们发现，当面临较高的当地通货膨胀时，个人投资者会购买更少的股票（卖出更多股票）。这种效应在不太成熟的投资者中更为明显。此外，我们记录了当地通货膨胀与股票卖出后放弃的回报之间的正相关关系。我们的发现与个人投资者遭受货币幻觉的影响一致。其他解释，如消费需求，不太可能驱动我们的结果。作者提供了互联网附录，可在牛津大学出版社网站上与最终发表论文的链接旁边获取。
